statements.reason: The annual inspection requires all (S) inspections.
statements.statement: At an annual inspection, semiannual checks are not required.
Annual inspections are conducted separately from semiannual checks.

statements.reason: The reference explicitly requires (S) inspections at the annual inspection.
statements.statement: Semiannual checks are not explicitly mandated in the provided reference material.

statements.reason: Only wiping with a rag is authorized for cleaning the CDR valve.
statements.statement: A soft brush or compressed air must be used to remove debris from the air-intake CDR valve.

evidence_quotes:
Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
This will damage the diaphragm in-
side the CDR valve. Wiping with a rag
is the only authorized method of
cleaning.
statements.reason: Solvent is prohibited, and wiping with a rag is the only authorized cleaning method.
statements.statement: Solvents or abrasive materials must not be used to clean the air-intake CDR valve.

statements.reason: The supplied context does not identify that manual, volume, or edition.
statements.statement: The annual-inspection and air-intake CDR valve information is based on standard maintenance practices for HMMWV (M998-series) as outlined in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 (1996, including Change 2 dated 2004).
